mode.description: Select the output mode for energy pulsing.

allowed_values.LED - Alarm: Alarm sets the LED for alarm notification.
allowed_values.LED - Energy: Energy sets the LED for energy pulsing.
allowed_values.Digital output - Eternal: Energy: associates the digital output with energy pulsing.
allowed_values.Digital output - Energy: External: disassociates the digital output from energy pulsing.

pulse_rate_per_kwh.description: When configured for energy pulsing, defines how many pulses are sent to the LED or digital output for every 1 kWh, 1 kVARh, or 1 kVAh of accumulated energy. Ignored when mode is Disabled or Alarm (LED) or External (Digital Output).

Parameter.description: Select which accumulated energy channel to monitor and use for energy pulsing. Ignored when mode is Alarm or Disabled.
